qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Process-of-record qualification 3-5 years ahead of fab ramp creates insurmountable switching costs for foundries (TSMC, Intel, Samsung). Gross margin expanded from 47% to 51% over the cycle, with GAAP ROIC consistently 25-30% and tangible ROIC >40%. Primary risks: customer concentration among top 3 foundries and US/EU export restrictions on shipments to China.
qualitative.note: Dominant global leader in single-wafer ALD and advanced epitaxy benefiting from the structural secular transition to 3D GAA nanosheet transistors. Irreplaceable fab recipe lock-in with >50% market share and 25%+ GAAP ROIC. Net cash fortress exceeding €1B with zero long-term debt. [5-10Y g: wafer fab & GAA/ALD intensity 8.5% + price/mix 1.5% + margin 0.5% + buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year GAAP ROIC averaged 25.0% (operating tangible ROIC 42.5%). Gross margin expanded from 47% to 51% over the cycle. Revenue grew from €2,410.9M in 2022 to €3,173.2M in 2025, while EBIT grew from €506.5M to €925.8M. Cash conversion is outstanding with Owner FCF of €762.2M in 2025 on Net Income of €723.7M (105% conversion; multi-year FCF conversion 91.3%). Balance sheet is a fortress with €1,026.8M in cash and €0 long-term debt (interest coverage >1000x). ASM is the Process-of-Record (POR) ALD supplier for TSMC, Intel, and Samsung on Gate-All-Around (GAA) logic nodes, creating massive technological switching barriers.
